summary: Pangi territory (Maniema) lies west of the South Kivu frontlines and no armed group is known to hold any secteur or town as of the reference date. Kalima (the main town), Pangi centre, Kampene and Kayuyu are assessed as PNC-policed with state administration and occasional FARDC presence. Rural villages are assumed under thin state presence. The eastern fringe bordering Shabunda (Kama, Kunda health zone, eastern Pangi secteur) is exposed to Raia Mutomboki incursions and is assessed with low confidence. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites egress-blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.

zones.description: Kalima town (former SOMINKI/Sakima tin-mining centre) and its contiguous quarters/villages in Kalima secteur (Kakutya, Bobela, Kinkungwa, Kamundala, Kakaleka health areas)
zones.evidence: Kalima is the largest town of Pangi territory with territorial/secteur administration, PNC commissariat and occasional FARDC units; no armed group is known to hold, tax or administer the town. Web research for this unit could not be performed (search budget exhausted, news/wiki sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Secondary administrative/commercial centres: Pangi (territorial seat, listed as Mabande/Mulamba), Kampene (mining centre) and Kayuyu (Centre Medical)
zones.evidence: Territorial seat and secteur centres with state administration and police posts; no report available to this run of armed-group control. Rests on default state presence. Web research for this unit could not be performed (search budget exhausted, news/wiki sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Rural villages of Kalima, Pangi and Kampene secteurs west of ~26.9E (Kalima, Pangi and western Kampene health zones)
zones.evidence: Rural villages and artisanal mining sites with thin police/administrative presence and customary authority; no armed-group control is known for these areas. Not verified by recent reporting. Web research for this unit could not be performed (search budget exhausted, news/wiki sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Eastern fringe toward Shabunda (South Kivu): Kama/Kirundu, Kunda health zone (Bikenge, Kabonga, Kapuli), Kisimba, Tchalumba, Bukama, and eastern Pangi secteur (Kyelu, Mukiti, Misisi, Penemagu)
zones.evidence: Gold-mining zone adjoining Shabunda territory, where Raia Mutomboki factions operate and have historically made incursions into Maniema around Kama and mining sites; no report available to this run shows an armed group holding these villages as of 2026, so they are assessed as thinly state-held.
